notes: Emails now set your name as type rather than fetching a logo image. Two different hosts both came through to Gmail as a broken icon while Apple Mail was fine, and an emailed image always depends on the reader's mail app going and getting it - which can fail in ways nothing here can reach. Type can't. The app's own preview and the PDF still use the real logo. If you get somewhere reliable to host it, App settings has a Web address for your logo field that switches the picture back on.
